title: The morphism C -> A[1] of a termwise split short exact sequence of complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and let $A^\bullet\xrightarrow{i}B^\bullet\xrightarrow{p}C^\bullet$ be morphisms of cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$ indexed by $\mathbf Z$ with $p\circ i=0$. Suppose given for every $n\in\mathbf Z$ morphisms $\pi^n:B^n\to A^n$ and $s^n:C^n\to B^n$ with $\pi^n\circ i^n=\mathrm{id}_{A^n}$, $p^n\circ s^n=\mathrm{id}_{C^n}$ and $i^n\circ\pi^n+s^n\circ p^n=\mathrm{id}_{B^n}$ (a splitting $B^n=A^n\oplus C^n$ compatible with $i$ and $p$; the $\pi^n$, $s^n$ need not commute with the differentials). Let $A[1]^\bullet$ be the shifted complex, $A[1]^n=A^{n+1}$, $d_{A[1]}^n=-d_A^{n+1}$. Then the morphisms $\delta^n=\pi^{n+1}\circ d_B^n\circ s^n:C^n\to A^{n+1}$ form a morphism of complexes $\delta:C^\bullet\to A[1]^\bullet$, that is, $\delta^{n+1}\circ d_C^n=-d_A^{n+1}\circ\delta^n$ for all $n$.
